decks.notes: The deck focuses on removing threats from the opponent while also gaining card advantage through Skeletal Scrying and Duress. It aims to control the board with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Vindicate, as well as board wipes like Wrath of God. The main win condition is to overwhelm the opponent with large flying creatures like Exalted Angel and Eternal Dragon, while also having access to board control options like Gerrard's Verdict and Decree of Justice. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and provide consistent access to black and white mana sources.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while establishing control through counterspells, removal spells, and land destruction. It aims to maintain board presence with efficient creatures and protective spells while using powerful control cards like Standstill and Armageddon to slow down the opponent. The deck also incorporates life gain and card advantage to outvalue the opponent in the long game. The key strategy is to outlast the opponent by managing threats and resources effectively, ultimately winning through incremental advantage and control of the battlefield.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build up a board of elves and utilize cards like Priest of Titania and Gaea's Cradle to generate large amounts of mana. This mana is used to play powerful creatures such as Multani's Acolyte and Elvish Champion to overwhelm the opponent with a strong aggro strategy. Survival of the Fittest allows the player to search for key creatures, while cards like Wirewood Symbiote and Quirion Ranger provide additional utility and flexibility in managing the board. The deck aims to win quickly through a combination of early aggression and powerful creature synergy.

The deck focuses on utilizing various control elements and the Survival of the Fittest card to tutor and utilize powerful creatures and disrupt opponent's strategies. It aims to control the game through hand disruption with cards like Cabal Therapy and Duress, while also utilizing recursion with cards like Recurring Nightmare. The deck also includes a range of creatures with powerful abilities to outvalue the opponent. The mana base is designed to support the color requirements of the deck's spells and creatures.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while gradually increasing its own power and advantage through efficient spells and creatures. It combines tempo control elements like Counterspell and Swords to Plowshares with card draw and manipulation tools like Gush and Opt. Quirion Dryad and Psychatog provide a growing threat that can quickly close out the game if not dealt with. The inclusion of Armageddon helps to reset the battlefield in the player's favor, while Meddling Mage names key cards to further disrupt the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing the speed and synergy of Goblins to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of aggressive creatures. By using cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to search for key pieces, along with support from Goblin Warchief and Goblin King to boost their effectiveness, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and finish the game before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Gempalm Incinerator and Rishadan Port helps to control the opponent's board and slow them down, allowing the Goblins to swarm in for the win.

This aggressive red deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast, direct damage from efficient creatures and burn spells like Ball Lightning, Lightning Bolt, and Fireblast. By maintaining a low mana curve and minimizing reliance on expensive spells, it focuses on consistently dealing damage to the opponent's life total while pressuring their resources. The inclusion of cards like Grim Lavamancer and Sulfuric Vortex further adds to its relentless, quick-paced strategy, making it a formidable force in the early game.

The deck focuses on utilizing creature abilities and control elements to out-value and disrupt opponents. It aims to efficiently tutor and deploy threats through cards like Survival of the Fittest and Sylvan Library. Tangle Wire and Tsabo's Web provide disruption, while creatures like Deranged Hermit and Triskelion offer powerful threats. The deck also incorporates mana acceleration with cards like Birds of Paradise and Gaea's Cradle, allowing for faster deployment of threats. Overall, the main strategy revolves around controlling the game while using creatures to maintain board presence and pressure opponents.

The main focus of this premodern BW Control deck is to maintain board control through removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Vindicate, while also disrupting the opponent's hand with Duress. The deck also utilizes powerful finishers like Exalted Angel and Eternal Dragon to close out the game. With a mix of removal, hand disruption, and powerful threats, this deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through attrition. Additionally, cards like Skeletal Scrying and Decree of Justice provide card advantage and help maintain card advantage throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck is to use the Fluctuator card to cycle through your deck quickly, allowing you to draw and play key combo pieces to overwhelm your opponent. By efficiently cycling cards like Cloud of Faeries and Pendrell Drake, you can generate mana and card advantage to set up a powerful win condition, often involving cards like Drain Life or Songs of the Damned. This deck aims to be fast, consistent, and resilient against disruption, making it a formidable force in a premodern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on quickly playing low-cost spells and creatures to put pressure on the opponent's life total. It uses disruptive elements like Counterspell and Meddling Mage to control the board while maintaining tempo with cards like Gush and Daze. The inclusion of Winter Orb and Portent also adds another layer of disruption, making it difficult for the opponent to stabilize. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and prevent them from establishing a strong board presence.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through various spells and creatures while also maintaining card advantage with Sylvan Library. It includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Naturalize, board wipes like Earthquake and Pyroclasm, as well as incremental advantage cards like Call of the Herd and Gaea's Blessing. The creatures in the deck provide value and help stabilize the board, while the land base enables consistency and mana fixing. This deck aims to outlast opponents and grind out victories through attrition and resource management.

The deck focuses on aggressively dealing damage to the opponent using low-cost creatures and burn spells, aiming to quickly reduce their life total to zero. By constantly pressuring the opponent with creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic, combined with direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate, the deck seeks to maintain a fast pace and prevent the opponent from stabilizing. The inclusion of cards like Ball Lightning and Sulfuric Vortex further increase the pressure on the opponent, leading to a swift victory if unchecked.

This deck focuses on utilizing the graveyard as a resource by discarding cards with Madness and filling up the graveyard to enable Threshold. The goal is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Basking Rootwalla, Wild Mongrel, and Arrogant Wurm while controlling the board with spells like Counterspell and Daze. Survival of the Fittest allows for powerful creature tutoring, ensuring the deck has the right threats at the right time. The deck also includes some disruption with cards like Waterfront Bouncer and Gilded Drake to disrupt the opponent's strategy.
